articles.title: Landmark Study of 20,000 Users Provides Peer-Reviewed Proof: InsideTracker's AI Health Platform Linked to Significant, Sustained Health Biomarker Improvements
articles.mainIdea: Landmark Study of 20,000 Users Provides Peer-Reviewed Proof: InsideTracker's AI Health Platform Linked to Significant, Sustained Health Biomarker Improvements
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Landmark Study of 20,000 Users Provides Peer-Reviewed Proof: InsideTracker's AI Health Platform Linked to Significant, Sustained Health Biomarker Improvements. InsideTracker today announced the publication of a peer-reviewed study in Public Library of Science (PLOS) analyzing longitudinal data from more than 20,000 users on its health AI platform. The retrospective study analyzes one of the largest multimodal, longitudinal datasets in the digital health sector, and found it was associated with measurable improvements in key health indicators across blood and wearable data. articles.title: Key takeaways from Trump's Iran war address as worries about his approval rating grow
articles.mainIdea: Key takeaways from Trump's Iran war address as worries about his approval rating grow
articles.summary: CBS News Videos: Key takeaways from Trump's Iran war address as worries about his approval rating grow. President Trump addressed the nation on the war in Iran as worries among White House officials grow about his declining approval rating. This comes as dozens of nations prepare to meet virtually to discuss the conflict in the Strait of Hormuz. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi, Holly Williams and Ramy Inocencio report.
